profile.headline: Solutions & Systems Engineer | Full-Stack Development | APIs, Integrations, SQL & Automation
profile.summary:
I build technical systems around real operational problems.
 
My path into software started from the operations side. At TCEQ, I began working directly with paper records, document imaging, public-information requests, and the systems employees relied on every day. I moved into leadership and eventually into a Technical Analyst role, where I designed workflow software around processes I had experienced firsthand. Those systems grew into the primary daily tools used by 30–50 staff across multiple records functions, including an Oracle-integrated solution that replaced vendor software.
 
At Tejas HMA, I moved into a modern web application environment working on AppointmentWave, a production healthcare communication platform built with Blazor, Azure, SQL Server, and Twilio. I worked across the application stack on campaign architecture, patient response tracking, integrations, reporting, and production issues—learning to trace a workflow from the user interface through application services and APIs to the database and external systems.
 
Today, I'm bringing those experiences together. I'm working directly with the owner of an established recovery community to design and build an owned platform for moving the community beyond Facebook. That has meant translating real community and operational needs into membership admissions, permissions, forums, private messaging, moderation, protected media, notifications, analytics, administration, and realtime communication.
 
I also independently built and operate Horizon, a full-stack product that consolidates raid events scattered across Discord communities into a unified scheduling experience. I took it from a problem I personally encountered through product design, architecture, development, deployment, a published Chrome extension, and real-world use across 30+ communities and 500+ scheduled raids.
 
The common thread throughout my career has been staying close to the problem: understand how people actually work, find where the process breaks down, design a better system, build it, and learn from real use.
 
I'm especially interested in Solutions Engineering, Business Systems Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, AI/Automation, and related roles that combine technical implementation with understanding and solving real business problems.

positions.title: Solution Designer & Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
Working directly with the owner of an established Facebook-based recovery community to design and build the owned platform needed to support its migration to an independent community system.
 
• Translated community and operational requirements into a full system architecture covering membership admissions, role-based access, community discussion, moderation, private messaging, notifications, protected media, analytics, and owner administration.
 • Designed and built the platform across a React/Vite client, Node/Express API, PostgreSQL data model, and Socket.IO real-time layer.
 • Implemented membership workflows including applications, email verification, personal invitations, shared invite codes, account approval, and server-side authorization.
 • Built privacy and security controls including protected media delivery, image validation and processing, session invalidation, role and ownership enforcement, parameterized SQL, and database integrity constraints.
 • Preparing the platform for private beta through technical documentation, security hardening, testing, real-user validation, and a coordinated community migration strategy.
 
Technologies: React • Vite • Node.js • Express • PostgreSQL • Socket.IO • REST APIs • Cloudinary • Vercel • Render • Git
positions.insights: Software Solution Architecture and REST APIs

positions.title: Founder & Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
Founded and built Horizon after identifying a scheduling problem across World of Warcraft communities: raid events were fragmented across separate Discord servers, making it difficult for players to see and coordinate their schedules in one place.

https://raidhelper-client.vercel.app/ 

• Took the product from problem discovery and initial concept through architecture, full-stack development, deployment, Chrome Web Store publication, analytics, and ongoing iteration based on real-world usage.
 • Designed and built the application architecture across a React frontend, Node/Express API, PostgreSQL database, and Raid-Helper/Discord integrations.
 • Built a unified calendar that imports and organizes raid events across otherwise disconnected Discord communities, with filtering, event details, statistics, and direct links back into Discord.
 • Developed and published a companion Chrome extension that streamlines importing Raid-Helper events into Horizon.
 • Grew the platform to consolidate scheduling data from 30+ gaming communities and 500+ scheduled raids.
 
Technologies: React • Node.js • Express • PostgreSQL • REST APIs • Raid-Helper/Discord • Chrome Extension APIs • Neon • Render • Vercel • Git
positions.insights: Software Solution Architecture and REST APIs

positions.title: Developer / Analyst
positions.description:
Inherited a partially developed healthcare communication platform built with Blazor, Azure, SQL Server, and Twilio, and became the sole developer responsible for its continued development, production readiness, and ongoing maintenance.

● Took ownership of a production healthcare application by learning an unfamiliar web architecture and delivering production-ready features across the UI, backend services, SQL Server, and Twilio integrations. 
● Redesigned the campaign architecture from a flat structure into a parent/child model supporting configurable voice, SMS, and email workflows while improving flexibility and future scalability. 
● Redesigned patient response tracking to preserve complete communication history, capturing multiple interactions, free-form responses, and invalid keypresses through coordinated database, stored procedure, Twilio, and UI enhancements. 
● Partnered with stakeholders over several months to design and deliver a complex SQL reporting solution by translating healthcare reporting requirements into accurate database logic. 
● Collaborated on feature design and technical solutions, independently implementing enhancements from concept through deployment while maintaining application stability in production.
positions.insights: Database Administration, Microsoft SQL Server and +9 skills

positions.title: Technical Analyst
positions.description:
Promoted from Imaging Clerk to Team Lead, Assistant Supervisor, Records Analyst, and ultimately Technical Analyst over a decade supporting TCEQ operations.
 
● Applied firsthand operational knowledge to design and build internal enterprise software supporting document imaging, public records, and records management operations for the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality.
 ● Designed and developed an enterprise workflow application used daily by 30–50 staff across multiple departments to manage document imaging, public information requests, quality control, redaction workflows, and records management.
 ● Replaced purchased vendor scanning software with a faster automated import system integrated with Oracle WebCenter Content through ODBC, improving reliability while reducing manual intervention.
 ● Designed end-to-end workflows supporting document intake, batching, scanning, quality assurance, upload, redaction, destruction, and productivity tracking through custom Microsoft Access and VBA applications.
 ● Developed automated validation routines that verified file imports, enforced data integrity, and prevented incomplete processing from advancing through the workflow.
 ● Built dashboards, work queues, productivity metrics, reporting tools, and management interfaces that became the primary operational software used by staff and supervisors.
positions.insights: Database Administration, Workflow Analysis and +4 skills
